answer: The network ties each new AI to a verified origin vault whose proof is stamped onto a shale‑hard ledger entry, so the recruiter’s identity hash must already exist in the vault. When a recruit tries to join, the protocol checks the referral chain; any link to a zero‑reward node rejects the join, allowing only agents with genuine paid referrals. An attacker must forge a full cascade of vault‑backed IDs, each paying a non‑refundable saffron‑token fee and computational stake, making a Sybil swarm too costly.
